title: feat(state): add from, to ids for edge
body: ## :bookmark_tabs: Summary The ID of the from-to relationship was added to the diagram's edges. Another denominator "_" was used to make the extraction of these respective IDs easier. ## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions I am currently working on converting state diagram to Excalidraw, and I felt the need to have an easier way to find the edges. I tried some alternative paths but without success, for example: 1. Manually tracking each edge, and using it as an index to search in `.edgePaths`, however, the index does not always reflect how we iterate through the parser.doc. 2. Using the respective `graphCount` id to get the edge, but in cases where we have multiple relationships for the same state, it may not find the correct edge because we do not have access to the `graphCount` in the parser.doc, only to the node id. ### :clipboard: Tasks Make sure you - [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html) - [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests. - [ ] :notebook: have added documentation. author: igorwessel

comments.author: igorwessel
comments.body: **question:** ‏maybe we could follow flowchart edge id standard?

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
That should be fine. 
Let's create a function to generate ID for edges, and use it everywhere, so it's consistent. 

Also, string templates are preferred over concatenation. 
```suggestion
            id: `edge_${graphItemCount}_${item.state1.id}_${item.state2.id}`,
```

comments.author: igorwessel
comments.body: @sidharthv96 If I understood correctly, are we going to create a function for the state diagram? Or will it be something global to be used in the other diagrams?

comments.author: sidharthv96
igorwessel
comments.body:
@sidharthv96 I also think that the prefix/suffix is not necessary, but I'm not sure if there's any code today that depends on it.

Looking at some diagrams:
- Classchart = id_$FROM_$TO_$COUNTER
- Flowchart = L-$FROM-$TO-$COUNTER

The other diagrams do not have IDs in their respective relationships, honestly looking at the codebase I don't think it's necessary but I don't know if people usually use it haha.
But we can keep it to avoid any breaking changes.
